findings.title: Member lookup crosses tenant boundaries
findings.detail: Campaign ownership is checked, but member IDs are fetched without a tenant condition, allowing another tenant member to be attached.
findings.recommendation: Scope member lookup to currentUser.tenantId and reject unauthorized IDs before inserting.

findings.title: Legacy export route references a missing screen
findings.detail: src/screens/legacy-export.jsx is absent from the source inventory.
findings.recommendation: Remove the route or implement and authorize its destination.

findings.title: Pro checkout requests Business
findings.detail: Both upgrade buttons submit plan business; selecting the displayed $29 Pro plan requests the $99 tier.
findings.recommendation: Send the selected validated tier and verify checkout pricing agrees with the displayed offer.

findings.title: Rejected fetch remains on loading screen
findings.detail: The catch handler sets error but never clears isLoading; the earlier loading branch hides the error forever.
findings.recommendation: Clear loading on failure and provide a retry action.

findings.title: Setup inputs are discarded
findings.detail: Priority and schema inputs have no state or submission wiring; Next only changes a local screen flag.
findings.recommendation: Persist meaningful setup values, label inputs, and remove internal schema configuration from this user flow.

findings.title: Invitation table reveals individual results and survey tokens
findings.detail: Named participant rows expose individualScore and the surveyHash despite the survey promise of private individual answers.
findings.recommendation: Remove individual scores and restrict bearer invitation tokens to an explicitly authorized delivery flow.

findings.title: Results unlock below promised privacy threshold
findings.detail: One completed response reveals the combined score and PDF link although the survey promises at least three completions.
findings.recommendation: Apply a shared minimum of three to results and export authorization.

findings.title: Modal lacks readable contrast and dialog semantics
findings.detail: The open modal uses #ccc on #fff and lacks dialog semantics, focus handling, and keyboard dismissal.
findings.recommendation: Use readable contrast and an accessible dialog primitive with focus restoration.

findings.title: Failed upgrade is permanently deduplicated
findings.detail: The event ID is inserted before upgrade execution; after a failure the retry is acknowledged as duplicate without reapplying the upgrade.
findings.recommendation: Commit successful processing and deduplication atomically or track retryable processing status.

findings.title: Signature verifier accepts stale signed requests
findings.detail: The timestamp participates in the HMAC but is never checked for freshness.
findings.recommendation: Reject malformed or out-of-window timestamps and support multiple v1 signatures.

findings.title: Upgrade target and entitlements rely on unchecked metadata
findings.detail: Organization is selected by email and first matching row; arbitrary tier and Number-converted seats become entitlements.
findings.recommendation: Bind verified customer/session IDs to an organization and derive validated entitlements from trusted prices.

findings.title: Concurrent upgrades lose seat additions
findings.detail: The worker reads seat_limit then writes an absolute sum; simultaneous events can overwrite each other.
findings.recommendation: Use atomic updates or a transaction with locking and define idempotent entitlement semantics.

findings.title: Completed checkout grants entitlements without payment check
findings.detail: Every checkout.session.completed triggers an upgrade without checking payment_status or asynchronous payment outcome.
findings.recommendation: Grant only for a verified paid checkout or appropriate payment success event.
